cards.latex: H(theta)=sum_even[K Sx_j Sx_j+1+Q(Sx_j Sx_j+1)^2]+sum_odd[K Sy_j Sy_j+1+Q(Sy_j Sy_j+1)^2], K=cos(theta), Q=sin(theta); W_even=Ry_j Ry_j+1, W_odd=Rx_j Rx_j+1
cards.role: Defines the physical Hamiltonian and the exact commuting blocks used for diagonalization.

checks.reason: The main text defines alternating X/Y bonds and two-site pi rotations.
A bond rotation either leaves its bond operator invariant or flips both adjacent spin components, so every W_j commutes with every bond term; integer-spin pi rotations commute on shared sites.
Restoring the missing pi in the second factor of printed W_(2j+1) is required by W_j^2=1 and by the supplement's explicit action.

cards.numerical_form: Filter Cartesian product configurations by r_axis(a_j) r_axis(a_j+1)=w_j, then assemble H only inside that exact block.
open_questions: The main-source definition of W_(2j+1) omits pi in its second exponential; the intended pi rotation is unambiguous from the rest of the paper.

cards.title: Ground-state MPS overlap

source_refs.value: overlap of this ansatz with the true ground state

cards.role: Defines the observable in main Fig. 5(a).

checks.reason: The main text and caption define the plotted quantity as the overlap with the true ground state.
Normalized vectors and Cauchy-Schwarz give 0<=F_GS<=1; at theta=pi/4 the selected MPS is an exact zero mode in its one-dimensional w sector, so F_GS=1.
The source labels the axis 'Overlap' but its plotted theta=0 values match the squared inner product, not its magnitude; for N=12, 0.90043^2=0.81077 agrees with the visible point near 0.81.

cards.numerical_form: Squared absolute normalized inner product of the lowest eigenvector in the uniform + sector and the matching MPS vector.
open_questions: The source does not release raw overlap values or eigensolver tolerances.

cards.title: First-excited-subspace MPS overlap
cards.role: Defines the basis-independent observable in main Fig. 5(b).

checks.reason: The caption specifies overlap with the space of N degenerate first excited states.

The projector expectation is invariant under arbitrary rotations within a degenerate eigenspace; because W sectors are orthogonal, a one-flip MPS reduces to the squared overlap with the lowest eigenvector of its matching one-flip sector.
At theta=0 the squared one-flip-sector overlaps reproduce the plotted values, including 0.89464^2=0.80039 at N=12.

cards.numerical_form: Squared absolute overlap in one fixed one-w-flip sector, cross-checked against the N-fold sector energies.
open_questions: The paper does not state which one-flip sector was plotted; translation plus X/Y rotation symmetry makes the choices equivalent.
